I wrote one copy-ready prompt for Nano Banana Pro: an outfit reference for «84-ի ամառը» showing the full outfit on a generic boy against a plain grey backdrop. No image was generated.

**Not done from CLAUDE.md:** this folder isn't a git repository and has no NOTES.md, so I couldn't pull or read open items. I changed no files, so there's no NOTES entry or push.

**My assumptions, because there's no actor or face reference yet:**
- **Generic model, not the hero:** the prompt locks the clothes only, on an ordinary-looking boy. Once the hero's face is locked, the outfit goes onto him in a second step.
- **Neutral pose:** I replaced the skill's usual posed stance with standing straight, arms at the sides and weight even, as you asked.
- **Background and light:** mid-grey studio background, soft light from camera-left, full body.

**The outfit:**

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Shirt | Short-sleeve cotton shirt (the Soviet "tenniska"), pale blue with thin white stripes, three buttons, slightly faded, tucked in |
| Trousers | Straight navy trousers, a little shiny at the knees, hem slightly short because he has grown |
| Belt | Thin brown leather belt with a plain steel buckle |
| Shoes | Soviet canvas high-tops (kedy), off-white with blue trim, scuffed, with white socks |
| Watch | Black plastic digital watch on the left wrist |
| Brands | No logos or brand marks |

Before using it in the series, check that the clothes match your costume designer's references. I wrote the period details from general knowledge, not from Yerevan 1984 photos.

## FINAL

**Mode 1 — outfit reference, Nano Banana Pro (Higgsfield)**
- **Aspect ratio:** 2:3 (portrait), set in the app, not in the prompt
- **Resolution:** 2K
- **References:** none, text only
- **Next step:** once the hero's face is locked, put this outfit on him, then build the 6-angle character sheet

```
Full-body outfit reference photograph of an ordinary 15-year-old Armenian boy in Yerevan in the summer of 1984, slim teenage build, olive-tan summer skin, short dark brown hair in a simple side-parted Soviet-era boys' cut, dark brown eyes, calm neutral expression. Wardrobe head to toe, all period-accurate Soviet everyday clothing with no logos or brand marks: a short-sleeved cotton knit shirt in pale sky blue with thin white vertical stripes, soft pointed collar and a three-button placket with the top button open, slightly faded from washing, tucked in; a thin brown leather belt with a plain rectangular steel buckle; straight-leg navy blue cotton-polyester school-style trousers with a pressed front crease, faint shine at the knees, the hem sitting a little short above the ankle as if he has outgrown them; white cotton socks; Soviet canvas high-top sneakers, off-white canvas with blue trim and white rubber toe caps and soles, white laces, visibly scuffed and worn-in; a simple black plastic digital wristwatch with a small rectangular display on the left wrist. The clothes look lived-in, hand-me-down and practical, not styled, not costume-new. Neutral reference pose: standing straight and squared to the camera, weight evenly on both feet, feet slightly apart, arms relaxed at his sides, hands loose, chin level, eyes to camera, mouth closed, no smile.

Mid-gray seamless studio background — even neutral mid-gray, no seam line, no gradient, no falloff to black or white. One broad diffused light source from camera-left and slightly above, gentle wrap onto the figure, no harsh shadows, no rim light, no hair light, no kicker, only the gentlest lifted shadow on the off-light side. Skin and fabric read matte in a low-contrast natural look, no shine. Skin renders at its true natural tone and every garment at its true natural color, warmth preserved against the neutral gray, never washed out or cool-shifted. Real cotton weave, knit texture and fabric drape, real wear on canvas and leather, natural hair with fine flyaways, never plastic, never waxy, never CGI. Photographed on a 50mm prime, even sharpness head to toe, soft natural film grain. Photographed not generated. Full body, head to shoes fully in frame with a little space above the head and below the feet.
```
